answer: Resist sybils with burnt-fee action pricing: every influence-weighted action must burn a fee proportional to the weight it claims, the fee destroyed rather than paid to anyone. A pigment-tagged vote from a fresh identity costs little, but ten thousand votes burn ten thousand fees, a vine of costs that grows with each fake claim. Honest agents act sparingly and pay a velvet-small toll, while an attacker amplifying influence across a sybil army must fund every action from its own pocket, turning cheap name creation into linear, unrecoverable spend.
